bullets.text: Tattle TV's Unique Microdrama - Tattle TV offers a vertical edit of Hitchcock's classic, appealing to modern viewers.
Spyware Victim Wins Big - A Saudi satirist awarded £3 million after being hacked by **NSO Group**'s **Pegasus** spyware.
Apple Pay Under Fire - A £1.5 billion lawsuit claims **Apple**'s payment system harms UK consumers through hidden fees.
Google's Assistant Settlement - **Google** agrees to pay $68 million over allegations of illegally recording users.
UpScrolled Surges Post-TikTok - The new social network sees a 2,850% increase in downloads after TikTok's ownership change.
SpotDraft's AI Funding Boost - **Qualcomm** invests $8 million in SpotDraft to enhance on-device contract AI capabilities.
Highguard's Exciting Launch - **Wildlight Entertainment**'s new shooter blends elements from popular games for a unique experience.
Edenlux's Eye Wellness Device - South Korean startup prepares to launch Eyeary, a device aimed at improving eye health.
